name: Braids
title: An Agent of the Cabal
summary: A ruthless and unpredictable figure whose activities helped the Cabal maintain its reach during the Mirari crisis.
biography: Braids served the Cabal in the era when its pit games and dementia magic shaped Otaria's political life.
She was involved in the movements and return of the Mirari after the artifact passed through the hands of rival powers.
Her original Odyssey card depicts the Cabal's uncompromising methods and the lives sacrificed to preserve its influence.

featuredCard.name: Braids, Cabal Minion
featuredCard.significance: Braids's original Odyssey portrait, representing the Cabal's harsh internal culture.

source.title: Wizards of the Coast — Commander Masters Storyteller, Part 1
